title: Badrinath Mana Village (2N/3D)
reportingPoint: Noida. The group departs in the evening; final pickup details are shared with confirmed travellers before the trip.
overview:
A long weekend yatra from Noida: this **2 Nights / 3 Days** group trip takes in the Ganga Aarti at Haridwar, the Devprayag sangam, Dhari Devi Temple, Mana, India's last village, and an early-morning darshan at Badrinath Ji (10,279 ft).

You leave Noida in the evening by AC traveller. Day 1 covers Haridwar, Devprayag and Dhari Devi on the way to a hotel in Pipalkoti or Rudraprayag. Day 2 is Mana Village (Saraswati Udgam, Bhim Pul, Vyas Gufa and Ganesh Gufa) and a night in Badrinath. Day 3 starts with darshan, and the group leaves Badrinath at 11 AM to reach Noida early on Day 4. Two hotel nights, 2 breakfasts and 2 dinners, all tolls and parking are included. Prices start at ₹7,999 per person on quad sharing (5% GST extra).
highlights: Devprayag, where the Alaknanda meets the Bhagirathi
Mana, India's last village before the border
Bhim Pul, Vyas Gufa, Ganesh Gufa and the Saraswati Udgam
Early-morning darshan at Badrinath Ji (10,279 ft)

itinerary.title: Departure from Noida
itinerary.content:
Assemble and depart from Noida in the evening by AC traveller.
Overnight drive towards the mountains of Uttarakhand.

itinerary.title: Haridwar, Devprayag and Pipalkoti
itinerary.content:
Stop in Haridwar to attend the holy Ganga Aarti.
Visit Devprayag, the sangam of the Alaknanda and Bhagirathi that forms the Ganga, then seek blessings at Dhari Devi Temple.
Arrive in Pipalkoti / Rudraprayag and check in to the hotel.
Dinner and overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Mana Village and Badrinath
itinerary.content:
Breakfast at the hotel, check out and depart for Badrinath.
Explore Mana, India's last village: the Saraswati Udgam, the Bhim Pul rock bridge, Vyas Gufa and Ganesh Gufa.
Arrive in Badrinath, check in and relax. Dinner and overnight stay in Badrinath.

itinerary.title: Badrinath darshan and return
itinerary.content:
Early-morning Badrinath Ji darshan.
Back to the hotel for breakfast and check-out. Depart Badrinath at 11:00 AM.
Drive downhill through the day and night, reaching Noida early on Day 4.

includes: 2 nights' stay: 1 in Pipalkoti / Rudraprayag, 1 in Badrinath
Transport, Noida to Noida (AC off in the hills)
All sightseeing as per the itinerary
Extra mattresses for triple and quad sharing
